title: Anti-Locking HOT Stats, Append-Only Ledger, and World-Class Stream Ergonomics
author: maintainer
description: Audited and hardened community stream schema to prevent row-locking under concurrent interactions. Created user_image_stats with fillfactor = 85 (enabling Heap-Only Tuple zero-amplification in-place updates) and user_image_interactions append-only ledger for double-vote prevention. Implemented non-blocking lock timeouts (200ms) and batch view impression telemetry. Upgraded stream UX with style preset chips, density switch (comfortable vs compact), persistent likes in localStorage, 1:1 zoom inspection, and mobile touch swipe navigation.
